weather.jaymoskingdoms.gesture: (The cartographer points at the sky, then counts off days on their fingers.)
weather.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.0: I read the sky for my charts, and I'd rather not read it for you.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.1: Ask someone else. I've nothing to say to you.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.spring.soft.0: The thaw is only %2$s days off, %1$s. Mind the mud and the late frost, and keep a wool cap by you yet.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.spring.soft.1: %2$s days, dear, and spring comes. The ice goes soft first: stay off the ponds.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.spring.soft.2: Winter's nearly spent, %1$s. %2$s days, by my charts. Don't put the cloaks away too soon.
Spring in %2$s days. Rain with it, and mud. Keep your waterskin full.
The charts say spring in %2$s days. The cold lets go slowly.
%2$s days to spring, %1$s. The floods follow the melt, so mind the low ground.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.spring.hard.0: Spring in %2$s days. Try not to be caught on thin ice.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.spring.hard.1: %2$s days and the thaw comes. Don't come crying to me when the roads turn to mud.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.spring.hard.2: Spring, %2$s days. Pack away the furs when it comes, not before.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.summer.soft.0: Summer is %2$s days off, %1$s. The sun gets fierce: a hat and a full waterskin will do you good.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.summer.soft.1: Warm days coming in %2$s, dear. Drink often, and rest in the shade at noon.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.summer.soft.2: %2$s days and it's summer. Bring a thermometer if you're crossing the sands, %1$s.
Summer in %2$s days. Hot noons. Carry water and wear light cloth.
The charts say summer in %2$s days. Drink before you're thirsty.
%2$s days to summer, %1$s. Storms come with the heat.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.summer.hard.0: Summer in %2$s days. Don't be the fool who walks the desert in iron.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.summer.hard.1: %2$s days to the heat. Pack water or pay with a headache.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.summer.hard.2: Summer, %2$s days. Bake if you like. I told you.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.autumn.soft.0: Autumn is %2$s days away, %1$s. Gather your harvest in time, and the rains will be kind to you.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.autumn.soft.1: Leaves turn in %2$s days, dear. A good time to lay in firewood and wool.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.autumn.soft.2: %2$s days and the cool comes. Mind the long rains, %1$s, and keep dry.
Autumn in %2$s days. Rain, and it often. Get your crops in.
The charts say autumn in %2$s days. Nights go cold first.
%2$s days to autumn, %1$s. Mend your roof before the rains.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.autumn.hard.0: Autumn in %2$s days. Get the harvest in or go hungry.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.autumn.hard.1: %2$s days to the rains. Don't whine about wet boots after.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.autumn.hard.2: Autumn, %2$s days. The cold nights start then. Dress for them.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.winter.soft.0: Winter is %2$s days off, %1$s. Lay in wool and wood, and find a fire to sit by of an evening.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.winter.soft.1: Cold coming in %2$s days, dear. Please wrap up warm, and come to our fire if you must.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.winter.soft.2: %2$s days and the snow comes. Stay close to hearth and home, %1$s.
Winter in %2$s days. Hard frost, little thunder. Get wool on your back.
The charts say winter in %2$s days. Stock food, wood and warm clothes.
%2$s days to winter, %1$s. The nights will freeze you if you let them.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.winter.hard.0: Winter in %2$s days. If you freeze, you'll have only yourself to blame.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.winter.hard.1: %2$s days to the cold. Get wool, or get used to shivering.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.ask.winter.hard.2: Winter, %2$s days. Don't come knocking blue-lipped at my door.
Oh, %1$s, a word: spring is only %2$s days off. Keep your cloak a little longer.
Good day, %1$s! The thaw is near, %2$s days. Mind the ice.
Just so you know, dear: %2$s days and spring comes.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.warn.spring.plain: %1$s. Spring in %2$s days. Thought you'd want to know.
My charts say the thaw is %2$s days away.
Spring comes in %2$s days. Mud and rain.
Spring in %2$s days. Keep out of the mud.
You there. %2$s days to spring. Don't say nobody told you.
The thaw's coming, %2$s days. Mind where you step.
Oh, %1$s, summer is only %2$s days off. A hat and a full waterskin would serve you well.
Good day, %1$s! It will be hot in %2$s days. Take water and find shade at noon.
Just so you know, dear: %2$s days and summer comes.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.warn.summer.plain: %1$s. Summer in %2$s days. Fill your waterskin.
My charts say the heat is %2$s days away.
Summer comes in %2$s days. Hot noons.
Summer in %2$s days. Pack water, or don't whinge.
You there. %2$s days to the heat. Don't say nobody told you.
Heat's coming, %2$s days. Wear less iron.
Oh, %1$s, autumn is only %2$s days off. Get your harvest in while the weather's kind.
Good day, %1$s! The leaves turn in %2$s days. Lay in wood.
Just so you know, dear: %2$s days and autumn comes.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.warn.autumn.plain: %1$s. Autumn in %2$s days. Rain and cool nights.
My charts say the rains are %2$s days away.
Autumn comes in %2$s days. Mend your roof.
Autumn in %2$s days. Get the crops in.
You there. %2$s days to the rains. Don't say nobody told you.
The rains are coming, %2$s days. Keep dry.
Oh, %1$s, winter is only %2$s days off. Get some wool on you, and come to a fire when you need one.
Good day, %1$s! The snow's near, %2$s days. Dress warm, dear.
Just so you know: %2$s days and winter comes. Please be careful.
weather.jaymoskingdoms.warn.winter.plain: %1$s. Winter in %2$s days. Get wool and firewood.
My charts say the cold is %2$s days away.
Winter comes in %2$s days. Hard frost.
Winter in %2$s days. Get wool or freeze.
You there. %2$s days to the cold. Don't say nobody told you.
Frost is coming, %2$s days. Stay near a fire.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.soft.0: %1$s? You're blue with cold. Come and sit by my fire a while, dear.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.soft.1: Oh, you poor thing, you're shivering! There's a fire just there. Come, I'll take you.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.soft.2: Come with me, %1$s. A seat by the fire will set you right.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.plain.0: You're freezing. There's a fire this way, follow me.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.plain.1: %1$s, you look half frozen. Come and warm up at the fire.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.plain.2: Come on, there's a fire not far. Sit by it a while.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.hard.0: You're shivering like a leaf. There's a fire that way. Follow, and be quick.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.hard.1: Freezing, are you? Come on, then. The fire's this way.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire.hard.2: Don't stand there turning blue. The fire's this way.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire_there.soft.0: There we are. Sit as long as you like, dear.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire_there.soft.2: Now you're by the fire. Take your time.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.fire_there.plain.1: There. Stay as long as you need.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.blanket.soft.0: Oh, %1$s, you're frozen! Here, I knitted this myself. Put it on, please.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.blanket.soft.1: You poor thing. Take this wool, it's warm and I have another at home.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.blanket.soft.2: Here, dear, a woollen shirt. Put it on before you catch your death.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.blanket.plain.0: You look half frozen. Take this woollen shirt.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.blanket.plain.2: Take this. It's warm, and you need it more than I do.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.blanket.hard.0: Here. Wool. Don't let me see you shiver again.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.blanket.hard.1: Put this on, %1$s. You're a sorry sight.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.soft.0: %1$s, you look faint in this heat! Come out of the sun, there's shade over here.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.soft.1: Oh, dear, the noon sun is cruel. Come with me, I'll show you some shade.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.soft.2: You're baking, %1$s. Come into the shade, please.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.plain.0: Get out of the noon sun. There's shade this way.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.plain.1: You're overheating. Follow me, there's shade near.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.plain.2: The sun's high and you're cooking. Shade's this way.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.hard.0: Out of the sun, %1$s. Now. Shade's this way.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.hard.1: Standing in the noon sun like a fool. Follow me to the shade.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun.hard.2: Get out of that sun before you drop. This way.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.soft.0: You're baking in this sun, dear. Find a roof or a tree, and rest.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.soft.1: Oh, %1$s, get out of the noon sun. Any shade will do.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.soft.2: The sun is cruel today. Please find some shade.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.plain.0: Get out of the noon sun. Find a roof or a tree.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.plain.1: You're overheating. Find some shade, and drink.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.plain.2: The noon sun's hard. Find shade.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.hard.0: Get out of the noon sun, %1$s. A roof, a tree, anything.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.hard.1: Cooking yourself in the open. Find shade.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_open.hard.2: Out of the sun. I'm not carrying you.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_there.soft.0: There, much better. Drink some water, dear.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_there.soft.1: Rest here till the heat passes, %1$s.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_there.soft.2: Cool now? Stay till the sun's lower.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_there.plain.0: Here's shade. Stay till the sun's lower.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_there.hard.0: There, shade. Stay out of the sun.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.sun_there.hard.1: Stay here till the sun's down. Don't make me fetch you.
notice.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.fire: (They point toward a fire and beckon you to follow.)
notice.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.fire_there: (They gesture at the fire: sit and warm yourself.)
notice.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.blanket: (They shake out a woollen shirt and press it into your hands.)
notice.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.sun: (They shield their eyes, point at the shade and beckon you to follow.)
notice.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.sun_open: (They shield their eyes and point to anywhere shady.)
notice.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.sun_there: (They pat the shade, then mime drinking.)
